description: Close a working session by writing a six-section record and, when something durable changed, one changelog row, so the next session starts from recorded state instead of archaeology. Use when the user closes the session or a substantial block of work reaches a natural close. Trigger phrases include "wrap up", "close the session", "we're done for today", "write the session summary", "log what we did", "that's it for now", "summarize this session". Also fire before a planned restart, since no skill runs on its own when a session simply ends.
